title: Wherever you ease a key, a segment, a row or the bar, you see one list of curves
goal: Today a key's right-click offers six Premiere eases while a segment, a row and the timeline bar with a segment picked offer the ten named curves plus Hold and Draw a Curve, and the two lists use the same words for opposite things. Make it one list everywhere, the one the animate mock draws: a key's right-click shows the ten curves, Hold and Draw a Curve, and Ease In, Ease Out and Bezier leave the key menu (settled on 2026-10-20, when the waiting cards were taken as recommended).
notes: Split out of the-timeline-bar-easing-sets-picked-segments-too (its checklist item 4). Mock docs/design/mocks/pages/video-animate.html (2026-10-12) line 406: Right-click a key or a segment: the easing list (the same ten curves everywhere, then Draw a Curve), Hold, Copy Ease, Paste Ease; its key carries the curve LEAVING it (k.e). User-sourced tasks of 2026-09-23 (keyframe-anything-and-see-and-shape-the-keys-on, move-a-layer-from-a-to-b-grow-it-shrink-it-fade) asked for Right-click a key: Linear, Ease In, Ease Out, Ease In and Out, Hold, Bezier. Name clash: curve Ease in = slow START (CSS); KeyEase Ease In = slow ARRIVAL at the key (Premiere), i.e. the opposite end of the stretch. Code: KeyEase.allCases in EditorState+KeyLanes.keyMenuRows, EditorState+ClipKeys.clipKeyMenuRows, TimelineDock.easingMenu (keys alone); EasingCurve list in segmentCurveRows / CurveRow.menu. Core helper PhotonzDocument.segmentsInHand(layerID:points:segments:) already maps a picked point to the segment it starts (last key: the one arriving), so one list on keys can reuse curveStretches. newKeyEase (bar remembers an ease for new keys) would need a curve equivalent. Walks expecting the key list: key-lanes-menu-walk, keyframe-anything-walk, timeline-bar-labels-only-walk, title-flies-in-grows-and-fades-out-walk, a-zoom-follows-the-cursor-walk, curves-on-a-zoom-and-a-dissolve-walk, pick-several-zooms-walk, every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk.
acceptance: A key right-click, a clip diamond right-click and the timeline bar with keys picked show the ten curves, Hold and Draw a Curve, and a curve on a key sets the segment it starts
No word means two different things in two menus: Ease In, Ease Out and Bezier are gone from the key menu
A walk at Next defaults eases a key and a segment from their right-clicks and reads the result in the bar

log.note: Waiting on the user: which list a key's right-click shows (decision card filed with a brief)

When the answer lands: the Camera row diamond's right-click (EditorState+CameraRow cameraKeyMenuRows) and the bar's Easing with a camera diamond picked also show the key list now, so they move with a layer key's menu.
